mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS clazzName, count( s.id ) AS studentCount FROM clazz AS c LEFT JOIN student AS s ON s.clazz_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY studentCount DESC, clazzName ASC

SELECT ( CASE degree WHEN 1 THEN 'Middle School' WHEN 2 THEN 'High School' WHEN 3 THEN 'Associate Degree' WHEN 4 THEN 'Bachelor Degree' WHEN 5 THEN 'Master Degree' ELSE 'Other' END ) AS name, count( id ) AS value FROM student GROUP BY degree ORDER BY degree ASC
